chunks: Who obstruct those who follow the path of God and try to make it oblique, who do not believe in the life to come.

key_terms.يَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا: They seek to make it oblique/crooked

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to make the path of God oblique and how does it relate to disbelief in the Hereafter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf is often linked to the specific group of disbelievers who actively distort the clear path of Islam, particularly through the introduction of bid'ah (innovation) and sectarian deviation. Their rejection of the Hereafter serves as the root cause for their deliberate obstruction of divine guidance, marking them as a distinct category of those who seek to make the straight path crooked.
